DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのようなご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to discuss?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 来月の旅行に現金を持って行きたいです。このカードの案内をもらいましたが、現金の両替もお願いしたことになっているでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: カード案内と現金両替の申込みの違いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to take cash on my trip next month. I received information about this card, but does that mean I have also requested a cash currency exchange?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how receiving card information differs from applying to exchange cash. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: カードの案内をお渡ししただけで、現金両替の申込みは受けていません。どちらへご旅行ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We only gave you information about the card; we have not received a cash exchange application. Where are you traveling?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ベトナムです。到着後に少額の現金を使う予定なので、必要な通貨を用意する方法を別に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 旅行先と到着直後の現金用途を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Vietnam. I plan to use a little cash after arriving, so I would like to ask separately how to prepare the currency I need.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State your destination and what you will use cash for immediately after arrival. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらで扱える通貨や手続き方法を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check which currencies we handle and how to proceed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。出発は来月十日です。その日までに準備できるか聞き、今日ここで受け取れるとは考えず予定を立てたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 出発日を示し準備可能な時期を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I leave on the tenth of next month. I want to ask whether it can be ready by then and plan without assuming I can collect it here today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give your departure date and check when the currency can be ready. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要な額は、お決まりでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you decided how much you need?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだです。初日の交通費などを調べてから額を決めます。カードで払う予定の買い物まで、現金の予算へ全部足すことはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 初日の現金予算をカード払いの予定から分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Not yet. I will decide after researching transport costs and other expenses on the first day. I will not add all the shopping I intend to pay for by card to my cash budget.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Separate your first-day cash budget from planned card payments. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 準備の方法と費用をご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will explain the preparation process and costs.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。今日は取扱いと準備日数と費用を聞きます。通貨と額を決めた後で、現金両替を改めて申し込みたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 取扱い日数費用を聞いてから通貨と額を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. Today I will ask what you handle, how many days preparation takes, and the costs. After deciding the currency and amount, I would like to make a separate cash exchange application.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask about available currencies, preparation time, and costs before deciding the currency and amount. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。取扱いの確認から始めます。お待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will start by checking what we handle. Please wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。お買い物で何かお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Are you having any difficulty with your shopping?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 冷凍野菜をまとめて買おうとしましたが、家の冷凍庫に入るか心配になりました。会計前に小さい袋へ選び直してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 冷凍庫の空きに合わせ小袋へ選び直したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was going to buy frozen vegetables in bulk, but now I am worried they will not fit in my freezer at home. May I choose smaller bags instead before paying?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to switch to small bags that fit the space in your freezer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 小さい袋はこちらです。大きい袋はまだ開けていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The small bags are here. Have you opened the large bags yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 開けていません。携帯に冷凍庫の写真があります。空いている所は小さい引出し一段だけでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未開封と写真で確認した空き場所を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, I have not. I have a photo of my freezer on my phone. There was only one small drawer with free space.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the bags are unopened and describe the free space you checked in the photo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 必要な量も確かめてお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please also check how much you need before choosing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日はスープ二回分です。家に冷凍の玉ねぎが残っているので、同じ玉ねぎまで追加せず、足りない野菜を小さい袋で買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二回の料理と家の残りから不足分を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Today I need enough for two batches of soup. I still have frozen onions at home, so rather than buying more of the same onions, I will buy the vegetables I lack in small bags.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose what is missing based on two meals and what remains at home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: まとめ売りの品は、こちらでお戻ししますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Shall we return the bulk items for you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。大きい袋を二つ戻し、小さい袋を一つにします。家へ着いてから袋を開けて別の所へ詰め込む前提で買うのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 大袋二つを戻し小袋一つへ数量を変更する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, please. I will return two large bags and take one small bag. I will not buy them assuming I can open the bags at home and squeeze the contents somewhere else.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Change the quantity by returning two large bags and taking one small bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ほかに冷凍品はございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do you have any other frozen items?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日はありません。この一袋を入れられる空きと、使う料理を確認できました。家の残りも使ってから、次の買い物を考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: ほかの冷凍品と保存場所と使用予定を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Not today. I have confirmed there is space for this one bag and what I will cook with it. I will use what remains at home before planning my next shopping trip.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm your other frozen items, storage space, and planned use. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。大きい袋はお預かりします。お買い物ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will take the large bags. Thank you for shopping with us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。園内で何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with anything in the park?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この木を描いていますが、枝の先が紙からはみ出しそうです。少し離れて全体を見る場所を探したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 枝が紙へ収まらず全体を見られる位置を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am drawing this tree, but the tips of its branches look as though they will go off the paper. I want to find a place a little farther away where I can see the whole tree.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a position where you can see the whole tree because the branches will not fit on the paper. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの通路の外から、全体を見られます。紙はどの向きでお使いですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can see the whole tree from outside this path. Which way are you using your paper?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 縦です。木の背が高いので縦にしましたが、横へ広がる枝まで入れると、幹がかなり小さくなりそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 紙の向きと全体を入れた時の縮小を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Vertically. I chose that because the tree is tall, but if I include the branches spreading sideways, the trunk will probably become quite small.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the paper orientation and how much smaller the tree becomes when fitting it all in. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: どの部分を描きたいか、決めてみてはいかがでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Why not decide which part you want to draw?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 幹の模様を詳しく描きたいです。全体を一枚へ押し込まず、今回は幹と下の枝を大きく描こうと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 幹の模様を優先して描く範囲を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I want to draw the patterns on the trunk in detail. Rather than squeezing the whole tree onto one sheet, I think I will draw the trunk and lower branches large this time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose the area to draw, giving priority to the trunk's patterns. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 枝の先は別の紙へ描きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Will you draw the branch tips on another sheet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 小さい別紙に全体の形を描き、どの部分を大きくしたか囲みます。本紙だけを見て木全体と思われないよう、幹の部分と題名を付けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 全体の別図に部分の範囲を示し題名を付ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will draw the overall shape on a separate small sheet and circle the part I have enlarged. I would like to title the main drawing “Part of the Trunk” so people do not think it shows the entire tree.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Indicate the selected area on a separate overall sketch and add a title. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 描く位置は決まりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Have you decided where to draw?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。通路へ道具を出さず、ここで幹を描きます。別紙の全体図と本紙の部分図をそろえて、今日の写生として残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通路を空け全体図と部分図を組み合わせて記録する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will draw the trunk here without placing my equipment on the path. I will keep the overall sketch on the separate sheet together with the detail on the main sheet as today's sketches.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep the path clear and record the drawing with an overall view and a detail view together. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。通行する方にお気を付けて、写生をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08234-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: All right. Please watch out for people passing and enjoy your sketching.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 改札へ入ってから、駅前の店に携帯を置いたことに気付きました。外へ取りに戻りたいのですが、この切符をどう扱うか、先に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 改札入場後に携帯を取りに戻るため切符の扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: After going through the ticket gate, I realized I had left my phone in a shop in front of the station. I would like to go back out to get it, but first I want to check how this ticket should be handled.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to handle your ticket when going back for your phone after entering the ticket gate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 携帯が店にあることは確認できていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you confirmed that your phone is at the shop?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。会計の時に台へ置き、かばんに戻した記憶がありません。店の名前は分かりますが、今も台にあるとは確認していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 店へ置いた経緯と所在の未確認を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I put it on the counter while paying and do not remember putting it back in my bag. I know the shop's name, but I have not confirmed it is still on the counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain how you left it at the shop and that its whereabouts are unconfirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まず店へ確認し、改札を出る際の扱いは係員へご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: First check with the shop, and consult the staff about leaving through the ticket gate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 同行者の携帯を借りて、店に保管されているか聞きます。自分の携帯へ電話するだけでなく、店の方と受取り方法も相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同行者の電話で保管と受取り方法を店へ確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will borrow my companion's phone and ask whether the shop is keeping it. Besides calling my own phone, I will also speak with the shop about how to collect it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Use your companion's phone to check with the shop about safekeeping and collection. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 店からお返事はありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you heard back from the shop?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 店で預かっているそうです。営業時間内に本人が来るよう言われました。同行者には、私を待たず予定の便に乗るか、相談して決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 保管の返事と同行者の乗車予定を分けて相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: They say they are keeping it. I was told to come in person during business hours. I would like to discuss with my companion whether they should take the planned service without waiting for me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Discuss the shop's safekeeping reply separately from your companion's travel plans. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 切符を確認します。ご希望の出入りを係へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will check your ticket and tell the staff how you would like to leave and reenter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。今は乗車せず店へ戻り、その後改めて移動する希望です。係の案内を聞くまで、切符を改札へ入れ直さずここで待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 店へ戻った後に移動する希望を伝え係の案内を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I would like to go back to the shop without traveling now and make my journey afterward. Until I hear the staff's instructions, I will wait here without putting the ticket back into the gate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to travel after returning to the shop and wait for staff instructions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。切符とご希望を確認してご案内します。お待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will check your ticket and wishes and advise you. Please wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのようなご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to discuss?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 交流会の案内を作っています。準備の八時半を、参加者全員の集合時刻として書いてしまいました。担当者と参加者の案内を分けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 準備担当の集合を参加者の集合として書いたと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am preparing an invitation to a social gathering. I mistakenly wrote the 8:30 preparation time as the meeting time for all participants. I would like separate instructions for the preparation team and participants.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you wrote the preparation team's meeting time as the participants' meeting time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 交流会が始まるのは何時でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: What time does the gathering begin?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 九時です。八時半は机を並べる人が集まる時刻で、参加者に準備を頼む予定はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 準備時刻と交流会開始を具体的に区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: At nine. Eight thirty is when the people arranging the tables meet; we do not plan to ask participants to help prepare.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Clearly distinguish the preparation time from the start of the gathering. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 案内の対象が分かるように書き分けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please word the instructions separately so the intended readers are clear.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。準備担当へは八時半、参加者へは九時開始と書きます。受付を何時から開けるかは主催者に、会場を使える時間は予約担当に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 準備集合と九時開始を分け受付開始と会場利用時間を各担当へ確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will write 8:30 for the preparation team and a nine o'clock start for participants. I will check with the organizer when reception opens and with the person handling reservations when we can use the venue.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Separate preparation from the nine o'clock start, and check reception and venue hours with the respective people responsible. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: すでに案内を受け取った方はいらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Has anyone already received the invitation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 参加希望の三人へ送りました。その三人には、八時半から作業をする必要はないと訂正して伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 既に案内した参加者へ訂正を知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I sent it to three people who wish to attend. I will send those three a correction explaining that they do not need to work from 8:30.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Notify the participants who already received the invitation of the correction. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 終了後の片付けについても、主催者とご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also discuss cleanup after the event with the organizer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。片付けは主催者の担当表で決め、参加案内へ勝手に追加しません。準備集合と交流会開始は書き分け、受付の時刻は確認できてから参加案内へ加えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 片付け担当と受付時刻を確認し準備集合と交流会開始を分けて案内する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. Cleanup duties will be decided on the organizer's duty roster; I will not add them to the invitation on my own. I will distinguish the preparation meeting time from the gathering's start and add the reception time once it is confirmed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm cleanup duties and reception time, and distinguish preparation time from the gathering's start in the invitation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。会場利用の確認は予約担当へお願いいたします。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please check venue use with the person handling reservations. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。受付で何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you at reception?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 仕事で手袋を使った日に手がかゆくなりました。手袋が原因と決めたわけではありませんが、使った物と作業の様子を先生に説明したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 仕事の手袋と手の変化を原因未確定の相談として伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My hands became itchy on a day when I used gloves at work. I have not decided the gloves were the cause, but I would like to explain to the doctor what I used and how I worked.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss your work gloves and changes in your hands without claiming the cause is established. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どのような資料をお持ちでしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 手袋の袋を持って来ました。実際に使ったのはこの商品ですが、袋の注意書きにあることが自分にも起きたと判断したわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 使った商品袋を情報として示す意図を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I brought the gloves' packaging. This is the product I actually used, but I have not concluded that what is mentioned in the package warnings also happened to me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you are showing the packaging as information about the product you used. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 使用した物の情報として担当へお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please show it to the clinician as information about what you used.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。作業の前は気にならず、終わった後に手の甲がかゆく感じました。作業中にいつ始まったかは分からないので、その間のことは分からないと話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 作業前後の状態と開始時刻の不明を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I did not notice anything before working, but afterward the backs of my hands felt itchy. I do not know when it started during the work, so I will explain that I do not know about that interval.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the condition before and after work and the unknown onset time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 作業の内容もご説明できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Can you also explain the work you did?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 箱を運び、その後片付けをしました。途中で手を洗ったことも覚えています。手袋だけの話で終わらせず、やったことを順に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 作業と手洗いを順に説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I carried boxes and then cleaned up. I also remember washing my hands partway through. I will explain what I did in order rather than only talking about the gloves.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain your work and handwashing in sequence. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 気になることは、診察で担当へご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please discuss your concerns with the clinician during the consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今後の仕事で何を確認すればよいか聞きたいです。手袋を替えるだけで済むとは決めず、今日の状態と作業の内容を説明して案内を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 仕事で確認する事項を医師へ相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I would like to ask what I should check for future work. Rather than assuming changing gloves will be enough, I will explain today's condition and the work I did and ask for advice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you would like to consult the doctor about what to check at work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。資料と作業の説明があることを担当へ伝えます。お待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will tell the clinician that you have information and an explanation of your work. Please wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのようなご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to discuss?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 歩道で自転車が植木鉢に触れた所を見ました。途中から見たので、最初からの経緯ではありませんが、私が見た部分をお伝えしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一部だけ目撃した自転車の接触を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I saw a bicycle touch a flowerpot on the sidewalk. I only saw it from partway through, so I cannot describe everything from the beginning, but I would like to report the part I saw.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss a bicycle's contact that you witnessed only in part. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どちらからご覧になりましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 店の入口です。前を人が通っていて、自転車が来る前の鉢の位置は見えていませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 目撃位置と人で見えなかった範囲を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: The entrance to a shop. People were passing in front of me, so I could not see the pot's position before the bicycle arrived.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your viewing position and what people blocked from view. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その後に見えたことを順に教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell me what you saw afterward, in order.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 鉢が傾き、自転車の人が止まりました。その人が鉢を起こす所は見ました。何かを壊したかは、近くで確認していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 鉢の傾きと自転車の停止と起こす動作を順に伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: The pot tilted and the cyclist stopped. I saw that person stand the pot back up. I have not checked close up whether anything was broken.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the pot tilting, the bicycle stopping, and the person standing it up, in order. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その方とお話しになりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Did you speak to that person?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、見たことを相談するつもりだと伝えました。名前は聞いていません。服の色は覚えていますが、持ち主か通りがかった人かは聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 相手との会話と本人情報の確認範囲を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, I said I intended to consult someone about what I had seen. I did not ask their name. I remember the color of their clothes, but I did not ask whether they owned the pot or were passing by.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain your conversation with the person and which personal details you checked. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 時刻と場所も伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will also ask the time and place.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日の午前十時ごろ、駅前の文具店です。入口から見えた接触と、止まって鉢を起こした様子をお伝えします。前の経緯や損傷は、私が確認したこととして加えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 場所時刻と実際に見た範囲をまとめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Around ten this morning, at the stationery shop in front of the station. I will describe the contact I saw from the entrance and the person stopping and standing the pot up. I will not add earlier events or damage as things I have confirmed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Summarize the place, time, and what you actually saw. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。目撃した場所と範囲を詳しく伺います。お話しありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will ask in detail about where you were and what you witnessed. Thank you for telling us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。郵便のことで何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help with anything about mail?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 同僚への寄せ書きを送ります。一人分の紙がまだ集まっていません。今日全部そろったように封をせず、発送の予定を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 寄せ書き一人分が未回収のため発送時期を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am sending a collection of messages to a colleague. One person's sheet has not been collected yet. Rather than sealing it today as though everything were here, I would like to discuss the posting schedule.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss when to post because one person's message sheet has not been collected. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お届けしたい日は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you decided when you want it delivered?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 来週の送別会までです。まだ書いている人には、今日中に私へ届くか確認します。郵便で届く日と、原稿を集める日を分けて考えています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 送別会の日と原稿回収の日を分けて伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: By the farewell party next week. I will ask the person still writing whether I can receive their sheet today. I am considering the postal arrival date separately from the date for collecting the messages.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the farewell party date from the message collection date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そろってから利用する方法と到着の目安をご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Once everything is ready, please ask about available services and estimated arrival.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。一人分を待てるか、先に返事を聞きます。その人の代わりに私がお祝いの言葉を書いて入れることはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人の原稿を待ち代筆で補わないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. First I will get a reply to find out whether we can wait for that person's sheet. I will not write congratulatory words myself and put them in on that person's behalf.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you will wait for the person's own message rather than fill it in for them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 未回収の方から連絡はありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you heard from the person whose sheet is missing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 明日の午前に渡せるそうです。ほかの人へも一日待つと知らせ、集まっている紙は折らずに保管します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 翌日の回収予定を聞き他の人へ知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: They say they can hand it over tomorrow morning. I will tell the others we are waiting one day and store the sheets already collected without folding them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain the next-day collection plan and notify the others. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 明日、そろった状態でお持ちください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。本人の一枚を加えて人数分を確かめてから、発送方法を聞きます。送別会に間に合うと先に約束せず、案内を聞いて相手へ連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 全員分の確認後に到着目安を聞いて相手へ連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. After adding that person's sheet and checking there is one for everyone, I will ask how to send it. I will not promise beforehand that it will arrive in time for the farewell party; I will hear your advice and then contact the recipient.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: After checking everyone's sheets, ask for the arrival estimate and contact the recipient. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お持ちいただいた時に、方法と到着の目安をご案内します。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. When you bring it, we will explain the services and estimated arrival. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What can I help you with?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 通帳に記帳したいです。窓口は三時までと書いてありますが、隣に記帳機は五時までとあります。今四時なので、どちらの入口を使うか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 窓口終了後に記帳機の利用入口を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to update my passbook. It says the counter closes at three, but beside it the sign says the passbook printer is available until five. It is four now, so I would like to check which entrance to use.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask which entrance gives access to the passbook printer after the counter closes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 本日は記帳だけで、窓口でのお手続きは必要ありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is it only passbook updating today, with no counter procedure needed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。入金や振込はしません。通帳だけ持って来ました。窓口へ相談する用事は別の日にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 記帳だけで窓口取引をしない用件を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I will not make a deposit or transfer. I only brought my passbook. I would like to leave my question for the counter for another day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you only need to update the passbook and will not make a counter transaction. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この掲示の記帳機は、奥の別入口からご利用いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The passbook printer on this sign can be reached through the separate entrance at the back.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 奥の入口ですね。窓口の入口が閉まっていても、同じ所を開けてもらおうとせず、記帳機の案内へ進みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 閉まった窓口の入口でなく別入口へ進むと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: The entrance at the back, then. Even though the counter entrance is closed, I will follow the directions to the printer rather than asking you to reopen that same entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm you will use the separate entrance instead of the closed counter entrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 別入口の場所を、この図でご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check this map for the separate entrance's location.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 図の右側にある入口を確認できました。友人へも、窓口が今開いているとは言わず、記帳機の利用を案内されたと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 案内図の入口を特定し友人へ機械利用の案内として伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have found the entrance on the right side of the map. I will also tell my friend I was directed to use the printer, rather than saying the counter is open now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Identify the entrance on the map and tell your friend you were directed to use the machine. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 利用日や時間は、それぞれの掲示をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the respective signs for available days and hours.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。今日の記帳機の時間を見て使います。別の日も五時までだと決めず、来る時に表示を確かめます。窓口の用事は窓口の時間で予定を立てます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 日別の機械利用と窓口の時間を分けて予定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will check today's printer hours before using it. I will not assume it is open until five on other days; I will check the display when I come. I will plan counter business according to counter hours.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Plan machine use by day separately from counter opening hours. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらの図で入口をご確認のうえお進みください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please check the entrance on this map and proceed. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。商品選びで何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you choose a product?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家で電気が使えない時の食事を少し準備したいです。お湯を沸かせない場合も考えて、そのまま食べる表示のある物を探しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 湯や加熱を使えない時の食事用の商品を探す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to prepare some food for times when electricity is unavailable at home. Considering that I may not be able to boil water, I am looking for products labeled ready to eat as they are.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Look for food products for times when you cannot use hot water or heating. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 手にお持ちの品は、調理方法をご覧になりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you checked the preparation instructions on the item you are holding?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 見ました。このスープは熱湯を入れると書いてあります。長く置けそうだから選びましたが、使う時にお湯が要ることを見落としていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 選んだスープに熱湯が必要だと気付いた経緯を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. This soup says to add boiling water. I chose it because it seemed to keep for a long time, but I overlooked the fact that I would need hot water to use it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain how you realized the soup you chose needs boiling water. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの品は、包装の調理方法を見比べてお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please compare the preparation instructions on these packages before choosing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この品には開けてそのまま食べられるとあります。開ける所も確認し、家に缶切りがなくても開けられる形か見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: そのまま食べる表示と道具なしでの開け方を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: This one says it can be eaten straight after opening. I also want to check the opening and see whether I can open it without a can opener at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the ready-to-eat label and how to open it without tools. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 原材料と、表示された保管方法もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also check the ingredients and the storage instructions shown.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。食べられない材料がないか自分で読み、開ける前の保管方法も見ます。食事用の品とは別に、飲み水の準備も家で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 原材料と保管表示と飲み水の準備を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will read for myself whether there are any ingredients I cannot eat and check how to store it before opening. Separately from the food products, I will also check my drinking water preparations at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check ingredients, storage instructions, and drinking water preparations. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 本日はどの商品をお選びになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Which products will you choose today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お湯を使うスープは今回は戻します。表示と開け方を確認した方を二つ買い、普段の食事でも食べてから買い足したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 湯が必要な品を戻し選んだ品の数量と試食予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will put back the soup that needs hot water this time. I will buy two of the item whose label and opening method I checked, try it as part of my regular meals, and then buy more.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Return the item needing hot water and state the quantity of the selected item and your plan to try it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。戻す品をお預かりします。お買い物ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08235-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will take the item you are returning. Thank you for shopping with us.
